proves: the Host obtained a direct-child process identity from spawn()
the Host observed a lifecycle event for THAT direct child
doesNotProve: that a downstream wrapper spawned the genuine DSH binary
that the provider/model route actually executed
that a remote model request occurred
that a descendant exited when the direct child exited
that the Work Attempt was canonically completed
that the artifact belongs to this attempt
observerFailurePolicy: a throw from the observer is swallowed; it cannot change the outcome or fabricate a Work terminal state; the consumer treats a missing observation as incomplete evidence
law: spawned.pid proves at most that the Host obtained a direct-child process identity; it does not prove a wrapper spawned the genuine DSH binary, that the provider route executed, that a remote request occurred, that a descendant exited with the child, or that the Attempt was canonically completed
